highlights.title: Fit Khitouli Marathon
highlights.text: A national-level run with around **3,500 participants** from across India and prizes worth **lakhs of rupees**.

highlights.title: Women’s Cricket Tournament
highlights.text: A rare first for our region — girls and women took the field. **Team Sunita Williams** lifted the title.

highlights.title: Bandhavgarh Clean-up
highlights.text: Volunteers cleaned the **Khitoli and Tala zones** of Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve and helped make them plastic-free.
